request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English, used as a 'listen and find' game scene: the learner hears a sentence and taps the matching subject. Natural everyday photographic detail, natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. Every subject named below must be instantly recognizable on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

A WAITING ROOM with a row of chairs and four adults seated well apart, from left to right: (1) a SICK woman wrapped in a blanket with a red nose, blowing her nose into a tissue; (2) an ANGRY man with arms tightly crossed, eyebrows pulled down hard and a deep frown; (3) an AFRAID woman shrinking back with wide eyes, open mouth and both palms raised, staring at a large spider on the floor in front of her; (4) a man who is FINE: relaxed and calm, sitting comfortably with a small easy smile and a thumbs-up. Each feeling is unmistakable at phone size. This is ONE single continuous photograph taken with one camera from one position: NOT a collage, NOT a grid, NOT side-by-side panels, no seams or dividing lines; the same ground and background run continuously behind every subject, and the subjects stand at slightly different distances from the camera like in a real scene. No letters, words, logos or brand marks anywhere. Every visible hand has five natural fingers.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-11-16; before tax, not an invoice.
